<a id="op-createreversal"></a>
#### Raise a reversal of a client's top-up (staff only, step-up)

```
POST /v1/ledger/staff/reversals
```

**Auth:** session token (`Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`) + a fresh step-up + VASPRO staff only  
**Operation ID:** `createReversal`

The maker of maker-checker. Only a client's top-up can be reversed, in whole or in parts; open and completed reversals of it never add up to more than it (VAL-4015). kind payback pays the money back through the rail; chargeback and operator skip the pay-back because the rail already moved it. clawback_services names the service wallets whose unused tokens may be clawed back, in order, if the main wallet falls short. Nothing is posted until a different staff member approves it. Staff only (AUTH-4025), with a fresh step-up (AUTH-4012); a transaction that isn't the client's top-up is VAL-4003.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string | A fresh unique value (e.g. a UUID) per action; reuse it only to retry the same request. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | string | yes |  |
| `original_transaction_id` | string | yes | The client's top-up being reversed. |
| `kind` | string: `payback`, `chargeback`, `operator` | yes |  |
| `amount_minor` | integer (int64) | yes | Minor units of the top-up's currency. |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |
| `evidence_document_id` | string | no | A document the client uploaded (accounts' documents), stored as given. |
| `clawback_services` | array of string | no | Service wallets to claw unused tokens back from, in order. |

Example:

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "0192c3a1-7f00-7000-8000-000000000001",
  "original_transaction_id": "0192c3a1-7f00-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
  "kind": "payback",
  "amount_minor": 1300000,
  "reason": "Client paid the same invoice twice",
  "clawback_services": [
    "sms"
  ]
}
```

**Response `201`**: The requested reversal.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `tenant_id` | string | yes |  |
| `original_transaction_id` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | string: `payback`, `chargeback`, `operator` | yes |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `amount_minor` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |
| `evidence_document_id` | string | no |  |
| `clawback_services` | array of string | yes |  |
| `status` | string: `requested`, `rejected`, `posted`, `payback_pending`, `paid_back` | yes |  |
| `requested_by` | string | yes |  |
| `approved_by` | string | no |  |
| `rejected_by` | string | no |  |
| `rejection_reason` | string | no |  |
| `reversal_transaction_id` | string | no |  |
| `payback_transaction_id` | string | no |  |
| `payback_reference` | string | no |  |
| `payback_attempts` | integer | yes |  |
| `last_payback_error` | string | no |  |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `decided_at` | string (date-time) | no |  |
| `preview` | object | no |  |
| `preview.covered` | boolean | yes |  |
| `preview.main_available_minor` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `preview.from_main_minor` | integer (int64) | yes | What the main wallet gives; negative when a clawback's rounding overshoots and the main wallet is credited back. |
| `preview.clawback` | array of object | yes |  |
| `preview.clawback[].service_code` | string | yes |  |
| `preview.clawback[].clawable_minor` | integer (int64) | yes | The wallet's unused, unheld tokens' value. |
| `preview.clawback[].tokens` | string | yes | Tokens the reversal would take back, a decimal with up to 6 places. |

**Operation ID:** `approveReversal`

The checker of maker-checker: a staff member other than the maker (VAL-4013), with a fresh step-up (AUTH-4012). At or above the country pack's threshold (KES 2,000 in Kenya) only a finance lead may approve (AUTH-4026). The reversal is posted at once: payback lands in payback_pending, the others in posted. If the main wallet and the named clawback can't cover it, nothing is posted (BAL-4007) and it stays requested. Only a requested reversal can be decided (VAL-4014).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reversalId` | path | yes | string |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string | A fresh unique value (e.g. a UUID) per action; reuse it only to retry the same request. |

**Response `200`**: The posted reversal.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `currency` | string | yes |  |

| `reason` | string | yes |  |

| `clawback_services` | array of string | yes |  |
| `status` | string: `requested`, `rejected`, `posted`, `payback_pending`, `paid_back` | yes |  |
| `requested_by` | string | yes |  |
| `approved_by` | string | no |  |
| `rejected_by` | string | no |  |
| `rejection_reason` | string | no |  |
| `reversal_transaction_id` | string | no |  |
| `payback_transaction_id` | string | no |  |
| `payback_reference` | string | no |  |
| `payback_attempts` | integer | yes |  |
| `last_payback_error` | string | no |  |

| `decided_at` | string (date-time) | no |  |

| `preview.from_main_minor` | integer (int64) | yes | What the main wallet gives; negative when a clawback's rounding overshoots and the main wallet is credited back. |

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VAL-4013` | 403 | A price's maker can't approve it | Every token price needs a second staff member to approve it (maker-checker), and the approver entered this price. |
| `AUTH-4012` | 401 | Step-up verification required | The session is signed in but hasn't proved fresh MFA recently enough for this action (system design §3's step-up list). |
| `AUTH-4026` | 403 | Finance lead approval required | The reversal is at or above the country pack's finance-lead threshold, and the approver isn't a finance lead (system design §4.3). |
| `BAL-4007` | 409 | Reversal not covered | The main wallet's available money plus the unused, unheld tokens in the named service wallets don't cover the reversal (system design §4.3). |
| `VAL-4014` | 409 | Price already decided | The token price was already approved or withdrawn, so it can't be approved again. |
| `AUTH-4010` | 401 | Invalid or missing credentials | The request's bearer token or API credentials are missing, expired, or don't match any account. |
| `AUTH-4025` | 403 | Staff only | This action is for VASPRO staff, and you aren't listed as staff. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |
| `VAL-4001` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with a different request body | The Idempotency-Key header matches an earlier request whose body hashes differently. |

<a id="op-listtenanttokenprices"></a>
#### The prices the account buys tokens at now

```
GET /v1/ledger/tenants/{tenantId}/token-prices
```

**Auth:** session token (`Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`)  
**Operation ID:** `listTenantTokenPrices`

Per service and currency, the tiers that apply now: the client's negotiated deal while one is in force (source deal), otherwise the list price's volume tiers (source list). A purchase uses the highest tier not above its quantity; a deal always applies, its lowest tier below all its tiers. <a id="op-createtokenpurchase"></a>
#### Buy tokens for a service from the main wallet

```
POST /v1/ledger/tenants/{tenantId}/token-purchases
```

**Auth:** session token (`Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`)  
**Operation ID:** `createTokenPurchase`

Moves the cost from the main wallet into the service's token wallet at the price in force, locked into a new lot. Buying is final: tokens never move back to the main wallet. Not enough money is BAL-4001, no price BAL-4005. The Idempotency-Key makes a retry return the same purchase. Needs billing:manage in the account (AUTH-4024 otherwise); an account the caller isn't a member of is VAL-4003, as if it didn't exist.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenantId` | path | yes | string |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string | A fresh unique value (e.g. a UUID) per action; reuse it only to retry the same request. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service_code` | string | yes |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `tokens` | string | yes | A positive decimal with up to 6 places. |

Example:

```json
{
  "service_code": "sms",
  "currency": "KES",
  "tokens": "10000"
}
```

**Response `201`**: The purchase.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | string | yes |  |
| `lot_id` | string | yes |  |
| `service_code` | string | yes |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `tokens` | string | yes |  |
| `minor_per_token` | string | yes |  |
| `cost_minor` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

```json
{
  "transaction_id": "0192f3e4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
  "lot_id": "0192f3e4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
  "service_code": "string",
  "currency": "KES",
  "tokens": "opaque-token",
  "minor_per_token": "opaque-token",
  "cost_minor": 1
}
```

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BAL-4001` | 402 | Insufficient balance | The wallet's available money doesn't cover the request (a token purchase from the main wallet, or a money hold). |
| `BAL-4005` | 409 | No token price for this service | There is no approved list price or deal in force for this service and currency, so tokens can't be bought. |
| `AUTH-4024` | 403 | Your role doesn't allow this | You are a member of this account, but your role doesn't include the permission this action needs. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `AUTH-4010` | 401 | Invalid or missing credentials | The request's bearer token or API credentials are missing, expired, or don't match any account. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |
| `VAL-4001` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with a different request body | The Idempotency-Key header matches an earlier request whose body hashes differently. |

## Payments API

### Other

<a id="op-gettopupdetails"></a>
#### Where and how the account tops up its main wallet

```
GET /v1/payments/tenants/{tenantId}/topup-details
```

**Auth:** session token (`Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`)  
**Operation ID:** `getTopupDetails`

VASPRO's M-Pesa paybill for the account's country and the account's own account number on it. A payment to that paybill with that account number credits the main wallet. The number is issued the first time it's asked for and never changes; it has two check characters, so a mistyped one is never credited to another account. Needs billing:read in the account (AUTH-4024 otherwise); an account the caller isn't a member of is VAL-4003, as if it didn't exist. PAY-6507 while VASPRO's paybill for the country isn't available.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenantId` | path | yes | string |  |

**Response `200`**: The paybill and account number.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rail` | string | yes | The payment rail, e.g. mpesa_ke. |
| `paybill_number` | string | yes | VASPRO's paybill (business number) to pay. |
| `paybill_name` | string | yes | The name the payer's phone shows for the paybill. |
| `account_number` | string | yes | The account number to enter; 8 characters, letters and digits without 0, 1, I or O. |
| `currency` | string | yes | ISO 4217, e.g. KES. |

```json
{
  "rail": "mpesa_ke",
  "paybill_number": "600100",
  "paybill_name": "VASPRO",
  "account_number": "ABC23456",
  "currency": "KES"
}
```

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH-4024` | 403 | Your role doesn't allow this | You are a member of this account, but your role doesn't include the permission this action needs. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `PAY-6507` | 503 | Rail refused or unavailable | The payment rail refused the request or couldn't be reached. |
| `AUTH-4010` | 401 | Invalid or missing credentials | The request's bearer token or API credentials are missing, expired, or don't match any account. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |


<a id="op-createtopup"></a>
#### Top up the main wallet by STK push

```
POST /v1/payments/tenants/{tenantId}/topups
```

**Auth:** session token (`Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`)  
**Operation ID:** `createTopup`

Prompts the payer's phone to pay VASPRO's paybill for the account's country, with the account's number as the reference. The wallet is credited only when M-Pesa confirms the payment, by the amount M-Pesa reports; poll getTopup or wait for the wallet.credited webhook. Replaying the Idempotency-Key returns the same top-up and never prompts again. An outcome the rail gives at once (refused, timed out) comes back as status failed with its PAY code, not as an HTTP error. Needs billing:manage (AUTH-4024 otherwise); an account the caller isn't a member of is VAL-4003. PAY-6507 while VASPRO's paybill isn't available.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenantId` | path | yes | string |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string | A fresh unique value (e.g. a UUID) per action; reuse it only to retry the same request. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount_minor` | integer (int64) | yes | In minor units of the account's currency, a whole number of shillings (STK pushes whole units). |
| `payer_phone` | string | yes | The phone to prompt, in E.164, e.g. +254708374149. |

Example:

```json
{
  "amount_minor": 150000,
  "payer_phone": "+254708374149"
}
```

**Response `201`**: The top-up, usually pending until the payer answers the prompt.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `status` | string: `created`, `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `expired`, `cancelled` | yes |  |
| `amount_minor` | integer (int64) | yes | The amount asked for. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `payer_phone` | string | yes |  |
| `account_reference` | string | yes | The account's number on VASPRO's paybill, sent as the payment's reference. |
| `receipt` | string | no | The M-Pesa receipt, once succeeded. |
| `error_code` | string | no | The PAY code, when failed, cancelled or expired. |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `completed_at` | string (date-time) | no |  |

```json
{
  "id": "0192c3a1-7f00-7000-8000-0000000000aa",
  "status": "pending",
  "amount_minor": 150000,
  "currency": "KES",
  "payer_phone": "+254708374149",
  "account_reference": "ABC23456",
  "created_at": "2026-11-11T09:00:00Z",
  "expires_at": "2026-11-11T09:03:00Z"
}
```

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH-4024` | 403 | Your role doesn't allow this | You are a member of this account, but your role doesn't include the permission this action needs. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `PAY-6507` | 503 | Rail refused or unavailable | The payment rail refused the request or couldn't be reached. |
| `AUTH-4010` | 401 | Invalid or missing credentials | The request's bearer token or API credentials are missing, expired, or don't match any account. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |
| `VAL-4001` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with a different request body | The Idempotency-Key header matches an earlier request whose body hashes differently. |

<a id="op-receivestkcallback"></a>
#### Receive Daraja's STK result (Safaricom only)

```
POST /v1/payments/callbacks/daraja/{railAccountId}/{token}/stk
```

**Auth:** none  
**Operation ID:** `receiveStkCallback`

Called by Safaricom's Daraja, not by clients, so it carries no session and no Idempotency-Key. Daraja can't sign callbacks: the source address must be one of Safaricom's published ranges and the path token VASPRO gave Daraja for this paybill must match; otherwise AUTH-4013 and nothing is recorded. A repeated callback changes nothing. One that arrives before the push it answers is recorded and applied as soon as the push is.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `railAccountId` | path | yes | string |  |
| `token` | path | yes | string |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Example:

```json
{}
```

**Response `200`**: Received.

```json
{}
```

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH-4013` | 401 | HMAC signature invalid or request expired | The request's X-Signature doesn't match its method, path, body and timestamp; the timestamp is outside the 5-minute validity window; or the nonce has already been used. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |

Called by Safaricom's Daraja before a payment to VASPRO's paybill completes, when external validation is enabled. **Parameters**

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | path | yes | string |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string | A fresh unique value (e.g. a UUID) per action; reuse it only to retry the same request. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payer_phone` | string | yes | E.164, e.g. +254708374149. |

Example:

```json
{
  "payer_phone": "+254708374149"
}
```

**Response `201`**: The payment, usually pending until the payer answers.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | string | yes |  |
| `status` | string: `created`, `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `expired`, `cancelled` | yes |  |
| `error_code` | string | no |  |

```json
{
  "payment_id": "0192f3e4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
  "status": "created",
  "error_code": "string"
}
```

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VAL-4014` | 409 | Price already decided | The token price was already approved or withdrawn, so it can't be approved again. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. |
| `RATE-4290` | 429 | Rate limit exceeded | This credential has made more requests than its configured rate limit allows in the current window. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |
| `VAL-4001` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with a different request body | The Idempotency-Key header matches an earlier request whose body hashes differently. |

<a id="op-createstatementimport"></a>
#### Import and reconcile a day's paybill statement (staff only)

```
POST /v1/payments/staff/statement-imports
```

**Auth:** session token (`Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`) + VASPRO staff only  
**Operation ID:** `createStatementImport`

Staff upload the M-Pesa org portal's statement export for one of VASPRO's paybills and one local day. Every completed payment in on it is matched to VASPRO's records by receipt, and every record of the day must be on it; every record must also be in the ledger's provider clearing for its amount, and every clearing debit of the day must be a record's. Each gap opens an exception. A day is imported once (VAL-4017). A file that isn't the export is VAL-4000 and nothing is recorded. Staff only (AUTH-4025).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string | A fresh unique value (e.g. a UUID) per action; reuse it only to retry the same request. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rail_account_id` | string | yes | VASPRO's paybill the statement is for. |
| `date` | string | yes | The local day the statement covers, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `csv` | string | yes | The org portal's statement export, as downloaded. |

Example:

```json
{
  "rail_account_id": "0192f3e4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
  "date": "string",
  "csv": "string"
}
```

**Response `201`**: Imported and reconciled.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `lines` | integer | yes |  |
| `matched` | integer | yes |  |
| `exceptions_opened` | integer | yes |  |

```json
{
  "id": "0192f3e4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
  "lines": 1,
  "matched": 1,
  "exceptions_opened": 1
}
```

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VAL-4017` | 409 | Statement already imported | A statement for this paybill and day has already been imported and reconciled. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. |
| `AUTH-4025` | 403 | Staff only | This action is for VASPRO staff, and you aren't listed as staff. |
| `AUTH-4010` | 401 | Invalid or missing credentials | The request's bearer token or API credentials are missing, expired, or don't match any account. |
| `VAL-4001` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with a different request body | The Idempotency-Key header matches an earlier request whose body hashes differently. |

---

## Error catalogue

Every code the platform defines. Codes from families that aren't live yet (messaging, routing, payments) are listed so clients can be ready for them.

| Code | HTTP | Title | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH-4010` | 401 | Invalid or missing credentials | The request's bearer token or API credentials are missing, expired, or don't match any account. | Sign in again or mint a fresh token; if the credential was revoked, issue a new one. |
| `AUTH-4011` | 401 | Two-factor code invalid or expired | The TOTP code or recovery code submitted doesn't match, was already used, or the sign-in challenge it belongs to expired. | Retry with a current code from the authenticator app, or an unused recovery code; if the challenge expired, sign in again. |
| `AUTH-4012` | 401 | Step-up verification required | The session is signed in but hasn't proved fresh MFA recently enough for this action. | Complete a step-up verification (TOTP code, or an emailed one-time code) and retry. |
| `AUTH-4013` | 401 | HMAC signature invalid or request expired | The request's X-Signature doesn't match its method, path, body and timestamp; the timestamp is outside the 5-minute validity window; or the nonce has already been used. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. | Recompute the signature over the exact request as sent, with a fresh timestamp and a fresh nonce, and retry. |
| `AUTH-4014` | 403 | Required scope missing | The credential's token doesn't include a scope this route requires. | Request a token with the needed scope, or use a different credential that has it. |
| `AUTH-4015` | 403 | IP address not allowed | The caller's IP address isn't on this credential's ip_allowlist. | Call from an allowed IP, or add the caller's IP to the credential's ip_allowlist. |
| `AUTH-4016` | 403 | Credential environment mismatch | A sandbox credential's token was used to call a route that only live credentials may reach. | Use a live credential, or call the route from a sandbox-eligible context. |
| `AUTH-4018` | 401 | External sign-in failed | The Sign in with Google flow failed - an unknown, reused or mismatched state; a failed code exchange; an ID token with a bad signature, wrong issuer or audience, past expiry or another flow's nonce; or an unverified Google email at sign-up. Deliberately not distinguished. | Start Sign in with Google again from the beginning. |
| `AUTH-4019` | 403 | Sign in with your organisation's single sign-on | The email's domain has an enabled single sign-on connection, so Sign in with Google isn't allowed for it. | Sign in through your organisation's single sign-on. |
| `AUTH-4020` | 409 | Account exists; link Google first | The Google account isn't linked to anyone, but its email belongs to an existing VASPRO account. VASPRO never links accounts silently. | Sign in with your password or passkey, then link Google from security settings. |
| `AUTH-4021` | 409 | Google account linked to another user | The Google account being linked is already linked to a different VASPRO user. | Unlink it from the other account first, or link a different Google account. |
| `AUTH-4022` | 409 | Can't remove your only way to sign in | Unlinking Google would leave the account with no password and no passkey. | Set a password or register a passkey, then unlink Google. |
| `AUTH-4023` | 403 | Select an account you belong to | API clients and SMPP accounts belong to a client account. This session has no account selected, or you are no longer a member of the one it selected. | Select an account you belong to (PUT /v1/auth/sessions/current/tenant), then retry. |
| `AUTH-4024` | 403 | Your role doesn't allow this | You are a member of this account, but your role doesn't include the permission this action needs. | Ask an Admin of the account for a role that allows it. |
| `AUTH-4025` | 403 | Staff only | This action is for VASPRO staff, and you aren't listed as staff. | Ask VASPRO operations if you believe you should have staff access. |
| `AUTH-4026` | 403 | Finance lead approval required | The reversal is at or above the country pack's finance-lead threshold, and the approver isn't a finance lead. | Ask a finance lead to approve the reversal. |
| `KYC-4020` | 403 | Account tier too low for this service | The tenant hasn't completed the KYC tier this service requires in this country. | Complete the next tier's verification, then retry. |
| `KYC-4021` | 403 | Not an active reseller account | Only an active reseller account can create sub-accounts; this account is direct or a sub-account, or it is suspended or archived. | Ask VASPRO staff to make the account a reseller (it needs the Financial tier), or reactivate it. |
| `VAL-4000` | 400 | Request failed validation | One or more fields in the request body don't satisfy the API's rules. | Fix the named field(s) and resubmit. |
| `VAL-4001` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with a different request body | The Idempotency-Key header matches an earlier request whose body hashes differently. | Use a fresh Idempotency-Key for a genuinely different request; resend the original body to replay the first response. |
| `VAL-4002` | 400 | Verification code invalid or expired | The submitted code doesn't match the most recent one issued for this address, has already been used, has expired, or has been guessed wrong too many times. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. | Request a new code and try again. |
| `VAL-4003` | 404 | Resource not found | The referenced resource doesn't exist, or doesn't belong to the caller. Deliberately not distinguished in the response. | Check the ID and retry; the resource may have been deleted or never belonged to this account. |
| `VAL-4004` | 409 | An account needs an Admin | This change would leave the account without an active Admin. | Make another member an Admin first. |
| `VAL-4005` | 409 | Already a member | The person invited is already an active member of this account. | Change their role instead of inviting them again. |
| `VAL-4006` | 409 | Business profile is locked | The business profile and its owners can't change while a business verification is in review or after it has passed. | Wait for the review's decision; changes after verification come with re-verification. |
| `VAL-4007` | 415 | File type not allowed | Documents must be PDF, JPEG or PNG files. The type is read from the file itself, not its name. | Upload the document as a PDF, JPEG or PNG. |
| `VAL-4008` | 413 | File too large | Documents are limited to 10 MB. | Upload a smaller file, for example a lower-resolution scan. |
| `VAL-4009` | 422 | File failed the virus scan | The virus scanner found something in the file, so it wasn't stored. | Scan the file on your side and upload a clean copy. |
| `VAL-4010` | 409 | Check already decided | The check isn't waiting for review any more; a reviewer or the vendor has already decided it. | Reload the review queue; decided checks leave it. |
| `VAL-4011` | 409 | Tier change not allowed | The account's tier can't move this way, for example more than one step on a check alone, a promotion of a suspended account, or no change at all. | Check the account's current tier and status, then ask for an allowed change. |
| `VAL-4012` | 409 | Price would overlap an active one | Approving this token price would leave two active prices for the same client, service, currency and volume tier at the same time. | Withdraw the price in force, or end it before this one starts, then approve again. |
| `VAL-4013` | 403 | A price's maker can't approve it | Every token price needs a second staff member to approve it (maker-checker), and the approver entered this price. | Ask another staff member to approve it. |
| `VAL-4014` | 409 | Price already decided | The token price was already approved or withdrawn, so it can't be approved again. | Read the price's status; to change an approved price, enter a new one and withdraw the old. |
| `VAL-4015` | 409 | Reversal exceeds the original | This reversal and the open or completed reversals of the same top-up together would be more than the top-up. | Reverse at most what's left of the top-up; a rejected reversal frees its share. |
| `VAL-4016` | 409 | Reversal isn't awaiting pay-back | Only a pay-back reversal that's posted and not yet paid back can record a pay-back. | Read the reversal's status; chargebacks and operator reversals have no pay-back. |
| `VAL-4017` | 409 | Statement already imported | A statement for this paybill and day has already been imported and reconciled. | Nothing to do; resolve its exceptions instead. A correction from the rail is a matter for its exceptions, not a second import. |
| `BAL-4001` | 402 | Insufficient balance | The wallet's available money doesn't cover the request (a token purchase from the main wallet, or a money hold). | Top up the wallet, or reduce the request. |
| `BAL-4002` | 402 | No tokens left for this service | The service's token wallet doesn't have enough tokens left (beyond those already held) for this request. | Buy tokens for the service, or turn on auto-buy. |
| `BAL-4003` | 409 | Hold can't change this way | The hold was already captured, released or expired, or the capture is larger than the hold. | Read the hold's status; capture at most its amount, and only while it's active. |
| `BAL-4004` | 422 | Tokens can't move back to the main wallet | Allocation is final - no posting moves money from a service or bonus wallet back to a main wallet, except an approved reversal. | Use the reversal flow, which needs a staff member's approval. |
| `BAL-4005` | 409 | No token price for this service | There is no approved list price or deal in force for this service and currency, so tokens can't be bought. | Ask VASPRO to set a price for the service in this currency. |
| `BAL-4006` | 403 | Account not open | The ledger account is frozen or closed, so it takes no new postings or holds. | Ask VASPRO support why the account was frozen or closed. |
| `BAL-4007` | 409 | Reversal not covered | The main wallet's available money plus the unused, unheld tokens in the named service wallets don't cover the reversal. | Name more service wallets to claw back from, release holds, or reverse a smaller amount. |
| `CMP-4030` | 422 | Blocked by a compliance rule | The request falls outside an allowed send window, or targets a number that opted out, for this country's rules. | Resend inside the allowed window, or remove the opted-out recipient. |
| `RTE-6020` | 422 | Sender ID not registered on this network | The chosen sender ID has no route on the destination operator. | Register the sender ID with that operator, or choose a sender ID that already is. |
| `DLR-7001` | 200 | Unknown or inactive number | The operator reports the destination number doesn't exist or is inactive. | Confirm the number with the recipient; remove it from future sends if it keeps failing. |
| `RATE-4290` | 429 | Rate limit exceeded | This credential has made more requests than its configured rate limit allows in the current window. | Slow down and retry after the window given in Retry-After. |
| `SYS-9000` | 500 | Internal error | An unexpected error occurred while handling the request (including a recovered panic). | Retry; if it keeps happening, contact support with the request ID from the response. |
| `SYS-5030` | 503 | Request timed out | The handler didn't finish within the service's configured timeout. | Retry; if it keeps happening, contact support with the request ID from the response. |
| `LIM-4501` | 429 | Daily message limit reached | The client's own configured daily send limit for this service has been reached. | Wait for the limit to reset, or raise it in the dashboard. |
| `PAY-6501` | 422 | Recipient wallet not registered | The destination mobile money account isn't registered with the rail for this payout. | Confirm the recipient's number and that they're registered for this rail. |
| `PAY-6502` | 504 | Rail timed out, status being checked | The payment rail didn't answer in time, so the outcome isn't known yet. | Don't resend. VASPRO asks the rail for the outcome and updates the payment; check its status. |
| `PAY-6503` | 422 | Cancelled by the payer | The payer cancelled the payment prompt on their phone. | Start a new payment if the payer wants to try again. |
| `PAY-6504` | 422 | Payer didn't respond | The payment prompt reached no one or wasn't answered in time. | Check the phone is on and has signal, then start a new payment. |
| `PAY-6505` | 422 | Payer has insufficient funds | The payer's mobile money balance couldn't cover the payment. | Ask the payer to add funds, then start a new payment. |
| `PAY-6506` | 422 | Wrong PIN entered | The payer entered a wrong PIN on the payment prompt. | Start a new payment and ask the payer to enter their PIN carefully. |
| `PAY-6507` | 503 | Rail refused or unavailable | The payment rail refused the request or couldn't be reached. | Retry later; if it keeps happening, contact support with the request ID from the response. |
